ticket.title: S17-T video claim fix: chapter 4 says the context pack is 40 KB by default; the code default is 8 KB. Re-render and replace every cut
ticket.description:
qa finding m-dbf4b571de (fail on c-50778c655b): Ch4Context.tsx:37 and :47 say the context pack is "40 KB by default", but bundles.py:602 sets the default to 8_000, and has since 0c2c501. The criterion requires each chapter's claim to match the code.

1. Fix the caption and the meter in v8/docs/video (Ch4Context.tsx) to 8 KB. Read the value from the code, not a guess, and derive the number from bundles.py if the composition can. Then sweep every other chapter's numeric or behavioural claim against its code pointer; a second wrong claim is the same bug.
2. Re-render with the one command: heronry-demo.mp4 (1920×1080, 60–95 s, with audio), plus the hero loop, gif and poster if any of them shows chapter 4.
3. Rebuild the README cut the same way as before (H.264/AAC, 1280×720, +faststart, ≤ 9.5 MB). Replace the committed `docs/readme/storefront/heronry-demo.mp4`, and `video-poster.jpg` if it changed. The site's /video/ page picks it up from there.
4. Update the storyboard doc's per-chapter code pointers, so qa can check each claim against the code.
5. Upload the new MP4 as a board video artifact for the owner, and post its id on the epic thread.
**Checks:** ffprobe (resolution, duration, audio), the PII grep over docs/video and the renders, the README storefront tests, and `mkdocs build --strict` (offline wheels).
**Rules:**
- Rendering is RAM-heavy, so check free memory first; the fleet has three other engineers live.
- Commit by path with both trailers, staging from a fresh HEAD.
- No fleet restarts. Leave the :8010 preview server running.
